title: Replace split_days tuples with a frozen DayPlan dataclass
prompt: `plan.split_days` returns plain tuples `(day, first_point, last_point, hours)` that callers unpack by position. Make it return instances of a frozen dataclass `DayPlan` instead, defined in `src/trailhead/plan.py`, with the fields `day`, `first_point`, `last_point` and `hours` in that order, and update every caller and test. Behaviour and command output must stay the same.

edits.new:
from dataclasses import dataclass

from trailhead.pace import leg_hours

DEFAULT_MAX_HOURS = 7.0


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DayPlan:
    day: int
    first_point: int
    last_point: int
    hours: float

edits.old: def describe_plan(days: list[tuple[int, int, int, float]]) -> list[str]:

bad.kind: split_days changed, describe_plan still unpacks tuples
